capabilities: Open any folder as a scoped file explorer in sidebars, editor area, or popout windows
Chain parent and child panels with cascading focus sync
Drill down into subfolders in place with a back-history stack
Filter, sort, and apply view presets per panel
Restore Folder Space views after restart
disambiguation: Not a workspace layout manager; layouts are saved and restored by a separate plugin, Window Spaces, while this one provides folder-scoped explorer views.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. README is trilingual (English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese). Exposes a public developer API documented in docs/api.md. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Folder Space reuses Obsidian's native File Explorer tree, so drag & drop, keyboard navigation, right-click menus
motivation: The author wanted to keep the benefits of a single vault while visually isolating one project or task at a time, since the default explorer forces every folder to compete for attention.
problem: Obsidian's default File Explorer shows the entire vault, which becomes a crowded tree once a vault spans many projects and topics.

relations.evidence: Pair Folder Spaces with Window Spaces to save and restore these layouts.
Folder Notes aware: option to disable folder-note opening in folder-only views

summary: Opens any folder as an independent, scoped File Explorer view with cascading panels, view presets, and in-place drill-down navigation.
